notes.title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction is a co-op stealth game sequel to Dawn of the Nugget that looks like good, silly fun
notes.content:
I'm not entirely sure of the cultural relevancy of Chicken Run, even if it did get one of those trendy legacy sequels back in 2023, and yet here we are with the reveal of an entire video game. The name of said game is Chicken Run: Eggstraction, and quite fittingly it is an action stealth game, one that might even look quite good?

notes.title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction | Announce Trailer
notes.content: [p]The chickens are back! Chicken Run: Eggstraction follows Frizzle on her first mission since Dawn of the Nugget to rescue chickens from twisted farms and villainous foes! [/p][previewyoutube="GOUTUOaPMs8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]You’ll sneak, solve puzzles, and rally your feathery crew to freedom between hilarious cut scenes packed with chaos and fun. 1–2 player co-op Stealth + strategy + laughs = eggstra fun [/p][p]Coming soon to Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and Steam! [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/hashtag/chickenruneggstraction"]#ChickenRunEggstraction[/url][/p]
